events.title: Emirates Villages Run Series: Al Rams (Ras Al Khaimah)
events.description: Round 6 of the Emirates Villages Run Series, a nationwide community run through heritage villages in all seven emirates. Distances of 1.5 km (family), 5 km and 10 km; open to all ages. Register online.

events.title: Emirates Villages Run Series: Al Shuwaib (final)
events.venue: Al Shuwaib Family Park, Al Shuwaib
events.description: Final round of the Emirates Villages Run Series, starting and finishing at Al Shuwaib Family Park. Distances of 1.5 km (family), 5 km and 10 km; open to all ages. Register online.
